card.title: 76 mm HOWITZER 1939
card.flavorText: The 76-mm Howitzer 1939 was a Soviet 76.2 mm cannon used in WWII by the Red Army. It was a designated divisional gun, issued to batteries under the direct control of division headquarters. The gun was produced from 1939 to 1941, with 9,812 units built, and it was used extensively throughout the war.
